text:
alertbot: [ALERT] hosted-usw2 pool-12 admission throttle engaged — p95 queueing > 2500ms, admission rate-limit applied. dashboard: https://redwood-internal/dashboard/pool-12

jess: ack. noticed a KV cache miss spike aligned with the admission events. miss rate jumped to ~22% for recent windows.

sam: correlating logs now — a bunch of warmup images got evicted around 14:21:03, then dozens of new requests caused sticky refills. seeing `kvcache.lookup` errors and backoff retries.

kai: quick triage: eviction windowing + concurrent refill surge -> sawtooth admission (queues spike, throttle, then refill adds pressure). we should smooth refill ramp and increase headroom for the short term.

jess: exact trace: `pool-12/node-7` had ~580 evictions in 30s, `kvcache.miss` events:
```
2024-09-17T14:21:03Z node-7 kvcache.miss model:v1 seq:128
2024-09-17T14:21:04Z node-8 kvcache.miss model:v1 seq:64
2024-09-17T14:21:05Z node-7 kvcache.refill start
```

kai: action plan I can run now: bump headroom to 25% on pool-12, disable aggressive eviction policy for 5m, and apply a 30s stagger to image warmups. command: `./ops pool adjust --pool pool-12 --headroom 25 --eviction-delay 300s --warmup-stagger 30s`

sam: +1 for headroom. also can we throttle refills per-node? current global refill bursts are killing the KV hotset.

devex: note — increasing headroom will shift cost for hosted to reserved spike. prefer short window (5-15m) and then revert, pls annotate billing tag `incident:usw2-kv-miss`.

oncall-bot: runbook step 2 triggered: #scale-headroom. Assigned to @kai. ETA 2 min.

kai: running commands now, will post result.

kai: done — headroom bumped, eviction delay set, warmup stagger enabled. CPU/p95 and queue depth should stabilize in next 90s.

jess: seeing p95 drop to 1.1s already for some shards, overall queue depth down ~40%. KV miss rate trending down to 7%.

sam: keeping an eye on routing fallback counts — they ticked up when we applied the throttle earlier. We should replay the admission windowing simulation tomorrow with the new refill params.

devex: tagging billing and creating a short note for the console (cost vs latency tradeoff).

oncall-bot: incident closed (mitigated). Please follow up with postmortem if trend recurs.

jess: filing follow-up ticket: "usw2: refill-smoothing + kvcache eviction tuning" with repro logs and simulation plan.

sam: optional: consider predictive prewarm for top 20 models in pool-12 during peak hours to reduce refill storms.

kai: agreed. will add to backlog and schedule a short runbook update. :)
